objective: Deliver normal and migration-package transfer workflows plus one responsive asset-management interface covering every confirmed operation and state.
users: Project users managing assets on desktop
Project users working from mobile viewports

requirements.statement: Support normal single/batch upload, single download and batch ZIP export with observable per-file progress and partial failure.
acceptance: A batch of up to 1000 files runs asynchronously
Users can retry failed files without repeating successes
counterexample: Hiding an entire batch result after one item fails

requirements.statement: Export and import ZIP64 migration packages with directories, files, controlled tags, append-only remarks and an integrity manifest.
acceptance: Export excludes favorites, shares, members, approvals and audit
Import re-scans every file and creates drafts
UUID conflicts and per-file failures appear in a result report
requirements.source: User-confirmed combined normal and migration-package option
counterexample: Trusting imported approval or permission state
Allowing path traversal or unbounded archive expansion

requirements.statement: Provide a unified desktop asset workspace with project context, lazy directory tree, paginated table, details and batch commands.
acceptance: All requested asset operations are reachable
Upload and transfer progress remains visible
Loading, empty, error, permission and partial-success states are distinct
requirements.source: Original unified-interface request and confirmed frontend design
counterexample: A marketing landing page instead of the tool
A page that requires frontend-only filtering

requirements.statement: Provide equivalent mobile workflows without compressing the desktop table or requiring drag and drop.
acceptance: 375x812, 390x844 and 430x932 have no page-level horizontal overflow
Directory, selection, move, upload and dangerous actions remain reachable
Light and dark themes are readable
requirements.source: User-confirmed responsive design and RDDMP H5 rules
counterexample: Shrinking desktop table text to fit mobile
Making drag-and-drop the only upload or move mechanism

invariants: Frontend project selection is not an authorization decision
Migration import never inherits source permissions or approval
No page-level horizontal overflow on required mobile viewports
Public UI components keep existing behavior
constraints: Vue 3 and existing Element Plus patterns

selected_approach.name: Asynchronous transfer jobs plus dedicated responsive data-migration frontend module
selected_approach.reason: Large batches and ZIP64 need persistent progress, while the operational UI must preserve desktop density and mobile reachability.

alternatives.name: Synchronous request/response ZIP generation
alternatives.rejected_because: Large packages would time out and lose partial-failure observability.

alternatives.name: One responsive desktop table
alternatives.rejected_because: It would create mobile overflow and inaccessible actions.

components.name: Transfer job service
components.responsibility: Run normal batch and migration-package operations with durable progress

components.name: Manifest validator
components.responsibility: Validate paths, sizes, compression ratios and hashes before import

components.name: Asset workspace
components.responsibility: Coordinate project, directory, filters, table/cards, details and commands

components.name: Transfer queue
components.responsibility: Display upload/import/export progress and retries without shifting layout

interfaces.name: Transfer job API
interfaces.contract: Create, inspect, retry and retrieve batch or migration-package results

interfaces.name: Asset frontend APIs
interfaces.contract: Typed project, attachment, asset, review and transfer operations

data_flows.output: Imported drafts plus UUID mapping and failures

error_handling.condition: Archive path traversal, excessive expansion or invalid manifest
error_handling.recovery: Correct the package and start a new import

error_handling.behavior: Continue independent items and record the exact failure
error_handling.recovery: Retry failed items from the result report

error_handling.behavior: Preserve project, directory and filter context and show a retry action
error_handling.recovery: Retry the affected region without resetting the page

error_handling.condition: Mobile action cannot use drag and drop
error_handling.recovery: Complete the same task through touch-accessible controls

security: No imported credentials or approval state
compatibility: Reuse shared UI and Project Context Store

verification_strategy.signal: Transfer outputs, manifest integrity, conflict mapping and per-file results
verification_strategy.method: ZIP fixtures, security tests, API integration and large-stream tests

verification_strategy.signal: Rendered states and reachable commands at required themes and viewports
verification_strategy.method: Frontend build plus real-browser desktop/mobile acceptance with network and console inspection

assumptions.text: A card list is the accepted mobile representation for assets
assumptions.basis: User confirmed the responsive interface design
assumptions.falsifier: A later approved design requires a different mobile comparison model

unknowns.question: Which named roles and synthetic fixture package will final browser acceptance use?
unknowns.impact: Must be fixed in the implementation scope and acceptance plan

decisions.decision: Support both normal transfers and migration packages
decisions.reason: They solve distinct daily and migration workflows

decisions.decision: Use separate desktop table and mobile card compositions
decisions.reason: Preserves operational density without mobile overflow

decisions.decision: Limit new styling to asset-specific directory, file-cell and upload-queue surfaces
decisions.reason: Keeps the feature within RDDMP shared UI and theme contracts

risks.risk: Large archives consume unbounded CPU, disk or memory
risks.mitigation: Streaming, entry/count/ratio/depth limits, quotas and asynchronous execution

risks.risk: Mobile parity is claimed from build output only
risks.mitigation: Mandatory real-browser acceptance at three mobile viewports and both themes

approval.evidence: User confirmed all seven design sections and selected the dedicated-module approach.
